name: Snow Under

name: Unforgetting Unforgiving
text:
Jarl Specialization
When this defends, if the attacking hero controls an equipment with a -1{d} counter, you may search your deck for a Mangle, banish it, then shuffle. You may play it during your next action phase.

text:

text:

text:
Earth and/or Ice Fusion

If Exposed to the Elements was fused with an Ice card, destroy an equipment with 0{d} controlled by target hero unless they pay {r}{r}.

name: Embodiment of Earth
text:

At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Embodiment of Earth.

name: Frostbite
text:
Cards and abilities cost you an additional {r} to play or activate.
At the beginning of your end phase or when you play a card or activate an ability, destroy Frostbite.

name: Seismic Surge
text: At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then the next Guardian attack action card you play this turn costs {r} less to play.
